messages:
Maya: idea - run an OSS refapp launch tied to a short tutorial series. goal: lower friction for devs trying Redwood and capture product-led usage signals.
Tom: nice. two-week sprint? want one live demo + three short tutorials (setup, bench, deploy).
Maya: exactly. week A: 3 tutorials released (5-10 minute each). week B: live demo + benchmark walkthrough + AMA.
Priya: lead capture thoughts: gated landing with HubSpot form, but allow anonymous repo access. form fields: email, company, use-case, "interested in dedicated" checkbox. add UTMs and a hidden field `campaign=oss-refapp-launch`.
Omar: for benchmark narrative let's pick: small-chat latency vs bulk embeddings throughput. show % cost delta when enabling prefix/KV cache + batching. keep metrics p50/p99 latency, throughput (tokens/sec), and $/1000 tokens.
Grace: distribution plan - blog post, dev newsletter, Twitter thread, LinkedIn + short clips. PR to OSS repo with a clear CHANGELOG entry and a `try-it` badge linking to the landing page.
Maya: owners: Tom -> tutorial repo + CI example, Omar -> bench notebooks + scripts, Priya -> landing + forms + GTM copy, Grace -> socials + blog. I'll own launch email and press/partners notes.
Tom: repo details: add `examples/refapp-quickstart` with `docker-compose.yml` and a tiny `Makefile` for `make run`. add a `bench.sh` wrapper to run the standard prompt set.
Omar: bench config (will commit to `bench/config.yaml`):
```
model: redwood/opt-lite-quant
sequence_len: 512
batching: dynamic
cache_policy: prefix_kv
metrics: [p50, p99, tokens_per_sec, cost_per_1k_tokens]
```
I'll include raw CSV outputs and a short notebook showing plotting.
Priya: landing copy draft subject lines to A/B test: "Try the Redwood refapp in 5 minutes" vs "See real latency wins with Redwood"; CTA: "Clone & Try" and secondary CTA: "Register for launch AMA".
Grace: can we make 3 short clips: onboarding (60s), bench highlights (45s), deploy to prod (60s). use captions and code overlays.
Maya: routing: HubSpot form -> tag `oss-refapp-launch` -> lifecycle=MQL -> webhook to /inbound/oss -> assign to Dev SDR queue if "interested in dedicated" checked. Priya, can you confirm webhook payload fields?
Priya: yes. sample payload: `email, company, utm_source, utm_campaign, interested_dedicated` -> will post example JSON once wired.
Tom: also add a `metrics.json` to repo to make bench reproducible and a `repro_steps.md`. helps devs reproduce our numbers.
Omar: agree. will include seed and docker env spec. I'll run baseline on hosted small instance and the tuned on dedicated pool to show delta; include instructions to run both.
Maya: timeline: prep + assets = 10 business days. soft announce to community Slack and Twitter 5 days before live. registration link open immediately.
Grace: I'll draft the blog outline: intro, why benchmarks matter, how we measured, results, how to try (link), next steps/CTA.
Priya: also recommend adding an automated drip to registrants: Day0 (welcome + repo), Day2 (bench highlights), Day7 (clip + join AMA).
marketing-bot: Reminder created for "OSS refapp launch - prep review" 3 days before planned announce. https://calendar.example/oss-launch-2145678901
Tom: pinging eng-docs for a quick README review and legal for the OSS license blurb.
Omar: I'll start bench runs tomorrow and post interim numbers.
Maya: awesome — I'll create the launch project board and add tasks with owners. thanks all :rocket:
